title: polypodium vulgare subsp. serratum
intro: Polypodium vulgare subsp. serratum, commonly known as the Serrated Polypody, is a subspecies of the common polypody fern (Polypodium vulgare) native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium vulgare subsp. serratum are attributed to its ability to stimulate the production of digestive enzymes, modulate the immune response, and exert anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
